settings.html:
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  const wire = (scope) => {
    const groups = scope.querySelectorAll('.elementor-form .elementor-field-group.elementor-field-type-upload');
    groups.forEach((group) => {
      const input = group.querySelector('input[type="file"]');
      if (!input || group.dataset._wired) return;
      group.dataset._wired = "1";

      const update = () => {
        if (!input.files || !input.files.length) {
          group.removeAttribute('data-filename');
          return;
        }
        // Handle single or multiple files
        const names = Array.from(input.files).map(f => f.name);
        const label = names.length === 1 ? names[0] : `${names[0]} + ${names.length - 1} more`;
        group.setAttribute('data-filename', label);
      };

      // Click anywhere on the styled box to open picker
      group.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if (e.target !== input) input.click();
      });

      input.addEventListener('change', update);
      update();
    });
  };

  // Run once for already-rendered content
  wire(document);

  // Run every time Elementor renders a Form widget
  if (window.elementorFrontend && elementorFrontend.hooks) {
    elementorFrontend.hooks.addAction('frontend/element_ready/form.default', wire);
  }
});
</script>
